cards.item_type: NO HOME IN THE TREE YET · PRINTED EMAIL FROM A FRIEND
cards.summary: Printed document on white paper.
cards.typed_words:
Re: YOU ROCK!! - Inbox - Yahoo! Mail

I do not have skype. But when I get to school I will have a phone (and I know, because I'm psychic, that the number will be 507-222-5955), and I'll be getting a cell phone one of these days. School doesn't start until the 15th, though, so I'm still at home, where the number is 267-235-9438... So you should call me and asking about painting the house, which is what I'm supposed to be doing all week. Also I want to hear about you!

Attached is the novella I wrote last year and used for the Book Class. At some point, if I can work our scanner, I can show you the illustrations I made for it, which are all pretty and shiny. And here is a sonnet for good measure, in case you haven't the time to read a novella right at the moment:

It's possible to walk on stepping stones,
if just your balance cautiously, go slow.
You might slip--bruise your ego and your bones.
So step. Pause. Worry. And you're safe. Although
The safest-looking stones can trip you up;
And every choice you ever reach with is done.
What have you proved but apprehensive luck?
So better to sprint to race, better to run
Over the rocks at full tilt, trusting gravity's grace
To let you leap lightly, step surely and keep up the pace,
For you're only in danger if you think too hard, slow and stall.
For you know although you'd fall harder, it's harder to fall
When you fly to your goal with a smile and the wind on your face
And your clod-footed fears left behind at the start of the race.

So anyway, Call me; I'll be home all day except from 3-6pm when I have to babysit.

Talk to you soon!

http://us.mc574.mail.yahoo.com/mc/showMessage?fid=Inbox&sort=date&order=down&sta... 9/3/2008

cards.name_on_card: Just what is wrong with me?
cards.item_type: NO HOME IN THE TREE YET · PRINTED LYRIC WITH ESSAY PAGE
cards.summary: A printed document on white paper with handwritten numbers on separate small paper slips placed to the left.
cards.typed_words:
Just what is wrong with me?
Maybe there is something wrong with us.
Find life in someone else
Living so vicarious-LY.
I took a minute to get away from myself
Decided to look through somebody else
Stared towards the street and the cars passing by
So many other souls maybe I'll give them a try
Looked at every car of every color
I soon discovered there were so many faces
Looked at all the people of every color
I soon discovered there were so many races
From my eyes I gave myself some advice
How can we be racist? It's the roll of the dice.
All the trees are green
I guess that's why they get along
So I'm just being me
That's why I sing this song
What else can you see?
You haven't seen all along
Hatred's only for the wicked
Eyes too [blurry/busy] colored to see
I'll tell them where to stick it
So if they ever come asking me!
---
Jensen 3

When the heat came down the next year, me and Cicotte, we were the first guys to admit what happened. I told the jury that I got paid the money but that I never made any intentional misplays, always batted to make a hit and always ran the bases to win. After all was said and done the jury only took three hours to find us not guilty. But the problem was that so many people were afraid of another fix that when Ban Johnson's three man commission changed to just one that Judge Landis wanted to make us an example to everybody else. The only wrongdoing I took part in was not telling Mr. Cominsky about the ring. And even though I set a record with 12 hits and hit .375 in the series and didn't make an error I was still banished from the game I love. I know for fact that if Mr. Cominsky rewarded us fairly for the year we had that no one on the team would have batted an eye no matter how much money the numbers runners were offering. Guys like Collins  [...cut for the check]

cards.item_type: NO HOME IN THE TREE YET · PRINTED PICKUP LINE SHEETS
cards.summary: White paper sheets and typed paper slips arranged on a surface, some secured with blue painter's tape.
cards.typed_words:
Most people call me [insert your name - it would be cool if your name was Tom], but you can call me tomorrow.
If I had four quarters to give to the four most beautiful women in the world, I'd blink three times and give you the entire dollar.
So, you wanna go halfsies on a bastard child?
Do you have a mirror in your pocket? Because I can see myself in your pants!
Are you an interior decorator? 'Cause when you walked in suddenly the room became beautiful.
Do you know what would look good on you? Me.
Did it hurt? When you fell out of heaven...
If I created the alphabet I would have put U and I together.
I'm new in town. Could you give me directions to your apartment?
Excuse me, but does this smell like chloroform to you?
If I had a nickel every time I saw someone as beautiful as you, then I'd have...a nickel.
Your legs must be tired because you've been running through my dreams all night.
Bam Bam... I'm no Fred Flintstone, but I can make your bed rock.
Something is wrong with my cell phone...it's just that your numbers not in it...
Hunny, there's only one thing I want to change about you and that's your last name.
See my friend over there? He wants to know if you think I'm cute.
Do you believe in love at first sight, or should I walk by again?
You must know karate 'cause your body's kickin'!
Is your last name Campbell? Cause you're mm...mm...good!
Sorry, but you owe me a drink...because I have an incredible urge to plant you right here.
Your name must be Daisy, because I have an incredible urge to plant you right here.
Do you work at the post office or for UPS? Neither? 'Cause I noticed you were checking out my package.
Excuse me beautiful, but can I get at least a fake phone number from you?
That shirt is very becoming on you, but if I was on you I'd be cumming too!
Damn, [...cut for the check]

cards.typed_words:
ESCAPING THE DEMONS

By Tom Jensen

- Poetry inspired by fighting against the
toughest opponent known to man - himself.

All poems within this book are about battling drugs and alcohol. The
purpose of this book is to offer inspiration to anybody who is fighting the
same disease as me. This is just one man's story. But it may be your story
as well. The goal of this collection of poems is not for profit; its only goal is
for sobriety.

Just biding my time
By reading slogans on the wall
A higher power is what I need
Maybe something above myself can set me free
For you can only tell what you're really worth
When you realize that you're not
The center of the earth
The sun does not rise for you
No matter how much you want it to
Gravity was made for many reasons
Something to do with the tide, the sun, the moon
And the changing of the seasons
It may be true that it pulls you down
But in order to walk the road ahead
First your feet must meet the ground
Then the rest is up to you
Use your better judgment if you want to
If you choose to walk back down the road
